verdict.rationale: 2FAS Pass is a password manager, so breach and weak/reused/exposed-credential warnings are a fair question for this product. The evidence pack covers storage, sync, security tiers, autofill, sharing and a password generator, but nothing about breach monitoring or password-health alerts. A password generator is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed
